companion_findings.statement: NEC, source/target projection, antisymmetry and cross-membership force explanatory-fact identity. If a unique total explainer may be freely padded upward by source parthood, every such superfact equals it; a proper larger fusion conflicts with that package.

companion_findings.title: Koons–Pruss exact probability and finite-exchangeability obstruction
companion_findings.disposition: Separate written quantitative/source interpretation findings retained.
companion_findings.statement: P(U|K)=alpha*d/(e+alpha*d); alpha=1 is the authors’ stated worst-case endpoint, not an omitted Bayes term. Coherence need not imply exchangeability; the exchangeable pair with masses 1/2 on 01 and 10 has covariance -1/4 and cannot be an iid Bernoulli mixture, whose covariance equals Var(Theta)>=0.
companion_findings.limit: Does not refute the correct infinite de Finetti representation theorem, the whole PSR argument, or positive foundational warrant; actual chance/causation interpretation still needs independent support.

companion_findings.title: Compatibility-component theorem
companion_findings.disposition: Separate standard graph theorem/application diagnostic, related to but not identified with current same-bearer propagation.
companion_findings.statement: If R(x,y) implies f(x)=g(y), source-local output labels are constant on every bipartite compatibility component; a finite graph with k components permits m^k labels from an m-element output set. Connectedness suffices and is weaker than complete Cartesian compatibility.
companion_findings.limit: Original metaphysical independence is not shown to imply connected admissibility, Cartesian recombination or the complete-determination premise. Source-world transport remains unproved.
